summary: @ronald_2008 Slowly but surely. We had a gypsy moth infection over last three years that took out all my oaks and and an Ash Beetle infestestation that has killed every ash in Connecticut.... I will be chopping wood for years.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @ronald_2008 Slowly but surely. We had a gypsy moth infection over last three years that took out all my oaks and and an Ash Beetle infestestation that has killed every ash in Connecticut.... I will be chopping wood for years.
